cardName: Deck title: FrizzleBob's Kafab-Alice in Blödsinn-Land
songLine: This is Blödsinn-Land. / Nonsense-Land, for the tourists.
reason: 'Blödsinn' kept as brand word: two hard syllables, works as a gang shout and is the deck's own interrupt call. Glossed once as 'Nonsense-Land' so English listeners get it; the gloss is the joke. 'Kafab-Alice' (printed title) is not sung: it breaks spoken and the deck bans Alice anyway.

cardName: Rules page: NEW RULE: BLÖDSINN! (Nonsense Check)
songLine: the second anything makes sense, the whole room yells / Blödsinn! / Laugh. Rewind. Keep falling.
reason: Printed 'If the story gets too logical ... yell BLÖDSINN! ... Laugh. Rewind. Continue.' compressed into the intro hook; 'Continue' changed to 'Keep falling' to set up the rabbit-hole rewind.

songLine: Smile: The Cheshire Cat, we're all mad here, I'm just honest about it; the grin stays, the cat goes, and that last card was never there.
reason: POWER 'GASLIGHT: remove a card, claim it was never there' used only as punchline, not as a rule.

songLine: Six o'clock sharp: The Mad Hatter, I murdered Time, now it's always tea; ten-and-six in the hatband, and I talk and I talk and I never stop to breathe.
reason: Printed 'eternal 6:00 PM' (digits read badly) becomes 'six o'clock' in the opener plus 'always tea'; hat label '10/6' spoken as 'ten-and-six'; FILIBUSTER power performed as breathless talk instead of a rule.

songLine: Shh: The Dormouse, breathing while I sleep is sleeping while I breathe; curled up in the teapot, humming twinkle, twinkle, little bat… scene over.
reason: Lore turned first person and shortened for rhythm ('Breathing while sleeping is the same as sleeping while breathing'); 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Bat!' from the page margin planted as a callback for Give Evidence; NARCOLEPSY as 'scene over'.

songLine: Eyes down: The Visitor, the Anomaly, a cryptid ape, I change size, don't look directly at me; no fur, static for a face, a whole galaxy in my dress.
reason: Parentheses in the card name dropped for speech; 'Do not look directly at her' moved in from the rules page; 'Ask the Dodo for classification' becomes the Dodo stanza beat that triggers the mid-song Blödsinn reset.

songLine: The Pool of Tears, I'm salty, somebody cried an ocean; the Dodo swims laps, the mouse panics, and everybody talks through a pinched nose.
reason: Telegram-style 'SALTY: All communication must be done while holding your nose' turned into a pun ('I'm salty') plus an image instead of an instruction.
Spelled 'Duchess's' so the possessive is sung ('Duchess-iz'); printed 'Duchess'' tends to be swallowed.

songLine: Hear ye: The High Tribunal, logic is forbidden in this court; twelve jurors with slates, one guinea pig cheered, into the sack, and if your story makes sense— / Blödsinn!
reason: Printed 'call "Blödsinn!"' kept verbatim as gang shout (brand word, see title entry); 'suppressed' guinea pig from the page margin rendered as 'into the sack'.

songLine: Pick a side: The Mushroom, one side grows you, one side shrinks you; flip a coin, and if it lands on the edge, your neck goes up like a serpent.
reason: Printed typo 'Neck grows like like a serpent' fixed; Heads/Tails shorthand opened up for speech.

songLine: The Squeaky Slate-Pencil, you're talking? Write it down instead; every word you say comes out screeeech.
reason: Image caption 'SCREECH' stretched to 'screeeech' so Suno performs the sound.

songLine: Quick, the brushes: Paint the Roses Red, somebody planted white by mistake; slap it red before the Queen arrives, or lose your head.
reason: 'QUEST:' label dropped (would stack two colons with the opener); 'Risk: Decapitation' spoken as 'or lose your head'.

songLine: Late again: Find the Gloves, the Rabbit needs his gloves and his fan; fetch them, Mary Ann! I'm not Mary Ann. Fetch them anyway.
reason: 'QUEST:' label dropped; 'Risk: Being mistaken for the housemaid Mary Ann' acted out as dialogue.

songLine: Solve the Riddle: why is a raven like a writing desk? / There is no answer. / So: why is a raven like a writing desk?
reason: 'QUEST:' label dropped; question and answer on separate lines; 'Infinite loop' performed by repeating the question instead of naming it.

songLine: Order, order: Who Stole the Tarts? The Knave did, we all watched him run; open and shut, except the evidence is a poem, and the poem makes no sense.
reason: 'Quest:' label and 'Goal/Risk' telegram dropped; the Knave running with tarts comes from the card image.

songLine: Take the stand: Give Evidence, I swear I'll recite it correctly; twinkle, twinkle, little bat, how I wonder what you're at—
reason: 'Quest:' label dropped; 'Risk: the words come out wrong' performed by reciting the wrong poem (callback to the Dormouse).

songLine: A tip from Uncle FrizzleBob: when the Queen gets angry, remember she's made of cardboard.
reason: Printed 'Pro Tip: If the Queen gets angry, just remember she's made of cardboard.' 'Pro tip' is already used as an opener in the 9/11 song, so it's reworded; this is FrizzleBob's only appearance.
